summary: Count() is added with the required signature and returns 1. TestCount asserts 1 and cross-checks against Exists over IDs -5..100. Find, Exists and their tests are unchanged. The only extra file is the work item the repository process requires, which AC-5 permits. The Verify gate's verify-fast and verify commands both exited 0 on the commit, which covers the Builder's note that it could not run Go.

findings.summary: Count keeps its own copy of the known-order data, so it can drift from Find. The cross-check test only covers IDs -5..100. The spec already identifies this as an accepted trade-off.
findings.required_change: Optional follow-up: share one package-level source of truth if the requester approves editing Find.

findings.summary: change-summary.md says no checks were run, but verification-result.json shows both verify commands passed. The scripts' contents were not inspected, so I cannot confirm that they run go test on this package. The result is consistent with the change being sound.

acceptance_criteria.rationale: func Count() int is defined in orders.go.
Count returns len of a one-element slice, which is 1, and Find knows only ID 1.
TestCount asserts Count() == 1 and agreement with Exists. The verify commands exited 0.
Find, Exists, TestFind and TestExists are textually unchanged. Only appended code is present, and verification passed.
The change touches the two Go files plus the process-required work item docs/work-items/WI-0006-order-count.md. I found no other changes.
